_doc: Sound effects of the ratio example: name -> [prompt, seconds]. python audio/gen_sfx.py examples/ratio makes media/sfx/<name>.mp3 (or --dry to preview).
tick: tiny soft wooden click for counting, single, gentle
whoosh: soft airy swoosh transition, gentle, short
ding: gentle bright bell ding, single, friendly, soft
chime: happy soft xylophone arpeggio rising, correct answer chime
sunrise: soft warm magical rising shimmer, short
bead: a single small glass bead sliding down a thread and clicking softly against another bead, bright, short, cute
buzz: soft gentle wrong answer buzz, playful, not harsh
pop: soft cute bubble pop, single, gentle, clean
